correctness.rationale: Free action follows because each nonidentity scalar of primitive prime order p has irreducible minimal polynomial of degree n and cannot stabilize a nonzero proper F2-subspace; rank-preserving flags have no inversions. Solomon–Tits gives simply connected cover B_n≃∨^{2^{n(n−1)/2}}S^{n−2} for n>=4, and Cartan–Leray gives H_odd<d=Z/p and H_even<d=0. Top integral homology is free because a d-dimensional finite cellular complex has free H_d; quotient Euler characteristic determines rank (2^{n(n−1)/2}+(-1)^d(1-p))/p. The mod-p Serre spectral sequence of B_n→Y→BC_p has no differential into row zero through degree d; c* preserves ξ and η=βξ products and is injective in degree d. For unbounded odd prime n and any p|2^n−1, ord_p2=n. Separate exact integer checks at (n,p)=(4,5),(5,31),(7,127) obtained top ranks 12,34,16514; original finite flag verifier was read, not blindly trusted. The finite checks do not establish the all-n cup products.
